7.stem_plain: We ________ the sunset on the beach when we spotted dolphins near the shore.

8.stem_plain: They won the match ________ their best player did not participate.

9.stem_plain: ________ cookies taste amazing. Here, have a bite!

10.stem_plain: We ________ very discouraged when we lost the game.

11.stem_plain: "We cannot go swimming now as it ________ heavily outside," Father explained.

12.stem_plain: We decided to go home to rest as we did not have ________ energy left after the race.

14.stem_plain: Every day, the boys will play football ________ recess.

15.stem_plain: I ________ how to ride a bicycle last Saturday.

16.stem_plain: Jane's cupcakes were so popular that ________ were left after the party.

7.note: 主句表示一个正在进行的持续性背景动作（在海滩上欣赏日落），中途被另一个突发的瞬间动作（看到海豚）所打断，因此需用过去进行时，主语 we 搭配 were admiring。
7.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Past Continuous Tense
7.zh: 我们正在海滩上欣赏日落时，突然发现近岸处有海豚。

8.note: 前半句“赢了比赛”与后半句“最好的队员没有参加”在语义上是让步转折关系，使用连词 “although” 表示“尽管”。
8.zh: 尽管他们最好的队员没有参赛，他们还是赢了这场比赛。

9.note: 后半句提到了 “Here, have a bite!”（来，尝一口！），说明饼干就在眼前（近指）；且修饰的对象 “cookies” 是复数，故选用近指复数指示代词 “these”。
9.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — these
9.zh: 这些饼干味道棒极了。来，尝一口！

10.note: 时间状语从句 “when we lost the game” 使用了一般过去时（lost），主句的系动词也应使用过去时；主语是 “We”（第一人称复数），因此选 “were”。
10.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Plural)
10.zh: 当我们输掉比赛时，我们感到非常沮丧。

11.note: 句中有提示词 “now”（现在），表明外面正发生着具有持续性的天气状况，需要使用现在进行时 “is raining”。
11.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Present Continuous Tense
11.zh: “我们现在不能去游泳，因为外面正下着大雨，”父亲解释道。

12.note: “energy” 是不可数名词，不能用 many 修饰；在否定句 “did not have...” 中，表示体力/能量“不多”，常用 much 进行修饰。
12.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — uncountable nouns
12.zh: 我们决定回家休息，因为比赛结束后我们没有多少精力了。

13.note: 句尾有明确的过去时间状语 “yesterday”（昨天），主语 “Amy” 是单数第三人称，因此系动词用 “was”。
13.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Singular)

14.note: 表示“在……期间”，这里指在课间休息期间，固定搭配用介词 “during recess”。
14.zh: 每天课间休息期间，男孩子们都会踢足球。

15.note: 句尾有明确的过去时间状语 “last Saturday”（上周六），动作发生在过去并已结束，需用一般过去时，learn 的过去式为 learned。
15.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Simple Past Tense
15.zh: 上周六我学会了怎么骑自行车。

16.note: 代词修饰的是复数可数名词 “cupcakes”；根据前文 “so popular”（非常受欢迎）可以推断出，派对结束后纸杯蛋糕剩下的“几乎没有”，表否定含义用 few。
16.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — countable nouns
16.zh: 简的纸杯蛋糕太受欢迎了，以至于派对结束后几乎没有剩。

1.stem_plain: The children jumped into the pool, causing water to ____________ over the sides.

2.stem_plain: The wooden bridge was strong and ____________ enough to hold the weight of many people.

3.stem_plain: The teacher ____________ the class that their efforts would be rewarded after the test.

4.stem_plain: I noticed a/an ____________ of excitement in his eyes when he saw the present.

5.stem_plain: The bus stopped ____________, causing everyone to fall forward.

6.stem_plain: Marianne delivers free food to the elderly living alone. She considers it a/an ____________ thing to do.

1.zh: 孩子们跳进泳池，导致水从池边泼溅出来。
1.note: “slosh”意思是“（液体在容器内）晃荡、泼溅”，最符合孩子跳进水池时水花四溅的动态语境。

choices.eg: Water continued to drip from the leaky kitchen tap.
The river began to swell after consecutive days of heavy rain.
The milk began to slosh over the rim of the cup as I walked.
A small stream of sweat began to trickle down his forehead.

2.zh: 这座木桥既坚固又结实，足以承受许多人的重量。
2.note: “sturdy”意思是“结实的、坚固的”，常用来形容建筑物或家具等结构牢固，能承受重压。

choices.eg: The target became stiff after being soaked in the rain for hours.
The truck drove down the broad avenue lined with trees.
The hikers wore tough boots to survive the rocky terrain.
We need a sturdy ladder to reach the top of the roof safely.

3.zh: 老师向全班同学保证，他们的努力在测试后会得到回报。
3.note: “assured”意思是“向……保证、使确信”，后面直接接人（the class），符合老师给学生吃定心丸的语境。

choices.eg: The doctor advised him to rest at home for a few days.
The manager assured the clients that the issue would be resolved.
The lifeguard cautioned the swimmers against entering the deep water.
The coach encouraged the team to keep fighting until the last minute.

4.zh: 当他看到礼物时，我注意到他眼里闪过一丝兴奋的光芒。
4.note: “glint”意思是“闪光、闪烁”，常与“in one's eyes”连用，形容眼神中流露出的微小神色变化。

choices.eg: There was an air of mystery surrounding the abandoned castle.
A glint of mischief appeared in the little boy's eyes.
A sudden flush of anger rose to her face during the argument.
The teacher gave the rowdy student a stern glare.

5.zh: 公交车突然停了下来，导致所有人向前倾倒。
5.note: “abruptly”意思是“突然地、出其不意地”，完美解释了车辆刹车过猛导致乘客因惯性向前倒（fall forward）的原因。

choices.eg: The train slowly pulled out of the station into the tunnel.
He hastily packed his bags because he was running late.
The music stopped abruptly, leaving the dancers confused.
She carelessly dropped her expensive glass phone onto the concrete floor.

6.zh: 玛丽安为独居老人送免费食物。她认为这是一件值得做的事情。
6.note: “worthwhile”意思是“值得做的、有价值的”，常用来形容做义工、做慈善等能带来社会价值或成就感的事。

choices.eg: The young man stood in a respectful silence during the ceremony.

choices.zh: 极有价值的、无法估价的
choices.eg: The mentor gave me some invaluable advice regarding my career path.
Visiting the museum was a worthwhile experience for the students.
The young pianist gave a phenomenal performance that amazed everyone.

17.note: 修饰名词 parents，指代 Sarah 和 Tom 两个人的父母，意为‘他们的’，故选 their。

18.note: 修饰名词短语 favourite kite，指代姐姐 Sarah 的风筝，用女性单数物主代词 her，故选 her。

19.note: 固定搭配 have something with someone，介词 with 后用宾格，指代单数男性 Tom 自己（随身带着），故选 him。

20.note: 作动词 played 的主语，指代上文的复数主语 'Sarah and Tom's cousins'（表兄弟姐妹们和他们一起），故选 they。

cloze: Sarah and Tom loved playing at West Coast Park. Every Sunday, [Q17] parents would take them there for some outdoor activities. Sarah, the elder sister, would bring [Q18] favourite kite, while Tom would always have his football with [Q19]. Last week, Sarah and Tom's cousins came along and [Q20] played together till sunset. It was so fun!
zh: 莎拉和汤姆喜欢在西海岸公园玩耍。每个星期天，他们的父母都会带他们去那里进行一些户外活动。姐姐莎拉会带上她最喜欢的风筝，而汤姆则总是随身带着他的足球。上周，莎拉和汤姆的表兄弟姐妹也一起来了，他们一起玩到日落。真是太好玩了！

31.stem_plain: The children do well for their examinations. Mother will bring them to the movies.

32.stem_plain: The robber wore a black mask. The robber was caught by the police.

31.concept: 条件状语从句 — Conditional Clause ('if')
31.zh: 如果孩子们考试考得好，妈妈会带他们去看电影。
31.note: if 引导条件从句，连接两个句子表达条件关系。主句使用一般将来时（will bring），if 从句使用一般现在时（do well）。
31.answer: Mother will bring the children to the movies if they do well for their examinations.

32.concept: 定语从句 — Relative Clause (Subject Pronoun 'who')
32.zh: 戴着黑色面具的强盗被警察抓住了。
32.note: who 引导定语从句修饰先行词 The robber。从句必须紧跟在它修饰的主语后，避免主谓隔离或修饰不清（也可写为：The robber who was caught by the police wore a black mask. 但通常戴面具是动作背景，被抓是主干，故前者更佳）。
32.answer: The robber who wore a black mask was caught by the police.
